_doc: Fields of pipeline result files that legitimately change between runs or interpreters. Used by assertion 4 in scripts/course_markdown.py: a re-run of the pipelines must reproduce the committed results byte for byte, except for the fields declared here (compared after masking ONLY these fields). Declare only timing, timestamps, timing-derived throughput/speedup/RAM measurements and interpreter version - never a scientific or numeric result. Keys are repo-relative paths. json_keys use dotted paths ('*' = any key/index); csv_columns (optionally restricted to rows where row_key is in row_values); line_rules mask regex 'mask' inside lines matching regex 'line'.
